file_roles.evidence: QWaylandWindow::reset() gains 'mWaitingToApplyConfigure = false;' so a stale pending-configure flag is not carried to the new wl_surface.

rationale: A configure for a destroyed wl_surface was applied after a new surface was created, hitting Q_ASSERT(m_pendingConfigureSerial != 0) in the xdg-shell plugin. The stale mWaitingToApplyConfigure flag lived in QWaylandWindow and was not cleared in reset(), which the diff fixes. The assert site is in a different file from the changed state.
